notes: Download all your data in one locked file and bring it to another computer. A redesigned setup, a new Intelligence page with a switch and an example for every step, Ecosystem and Portfolio that ask before they read anything, and memory that keeps itself straight.

changelog.headline: Your data, in your hands

sections.title: Your data
items: Download everything you keep in XOS1 as one file, locked with a data password only you know.
Bring that file into XOS1 on another computer. Pick what comes in, then add it to what is there or replace it.
You set the data password right after setup, and it is asked again every time you download.

sections.title: Setup
items: A calmer, redesigned setup page with the same smooth feel as the rest of the app.

sections.title: Intelligence
items: Settings has a new Intelligence page. Every step the AI takes has its own example conversation and a switch.
Steps the system can't work properly without, like keeping memory consistent, follow their parent and have no switch to break.
An ordinary message now takes four steps. Extra checks, like the honesty review, are off until you turn them on.
Speech now starts as soon as the first sentence is finished.

sections.title: Privacy and permissions
items: Your portfolio is now its own permission. The AI gives information only and never tells you to buy or sell.
Ecosystem asks before it reads anything about your PC. Nothing listens on your network until you allow it.
The Intelligence, Privacy and Ecosystem pages are rewritten in plain words.
The Wallet page is gone for good.

sections.title: Apps
items: Desktop shortcuts, like a game's own icon, now show up under Miscellaneous.
Your app list refreshes itself when it is more than 12 hours old, so a new game appears without pressing Refresh.
Refresh and hide are now one tidy button at the bottom of the sidebar.

sections.title: Memory
items: When something you say changes a fact on file, it now updates it, replaces it, removes it, or asks you, instead of keeping both versions side by side.
When it asks about a conflict and you answer, that settles it. It won't ask the same thing again.
People you mention are kept straight: no more phantom people from words like "my brother", and pets are filed as pets.
Facts are saved in English whatever language you spoke in, so they're found again later.
Recall now brings up what's nearby too: today's anniversaries, and the people who've been on your mind.
The nightly check-up only merges duplicates and asks about conflicts. It never quietly retires a fact.
Settings shows how many days each person you know has come up in conversation.

sections.title: Conversation
items: The AI tells you when it thinks you're kidding yourself, gives its reason, and doesn't take it back just because you didn't like it.
When something matters, it can ask the question you've been stepping around. When you're joking around, it can roast you back.
Ask the AI what XOS1 is, which company makes it, or who founded that company, and it will tell you.
When it writes to a note or a document for you, it now checks the result actually matches what you asked before telling you it's done. It says so plainly when it doesn't.

sections.title: Markets
items: A redesigned Markets page: live tape, index strip, market leaders, and a cleaner chart that never drops the latest point.
Every stock page now has a Financials tab with statements, ratios, growth, shareholding and dividends.

sections.title: Games
items: Put a game on hold and pick it up later. Leaving a game parks it instead of ending it, and you can also give up properly.
In chess, the AI now knows exactly which moves were yours and which were its own.

sections.title: Smoother everywhere
items: Smoother wheel scrolling, and lighter animations on the portfolio, settings and app windows.
Calendar searches by topic now find the right entries instead of loose text matches.
Moving, shifting or undoing several calendar entries at once, and bringing back a deleted note, now pick the right action more reliably.
If an update can't install, you see one plain sentence about what happened, and it retries on its own.

sections.title: Security
items: The app no longer keeps provider credentials on your PC. It proves which machine it is and borrows short-lived access instead, so there is nothing on disk for anyone to copy.

changelog.data_safety: Your chats, memory, notes, portfolio and settings stay exactly as they are. Updates only replace the app's own program files. Nothing you have created is touched or deleted.
